name: How long does painted cabinet finish last?

mainEntity.name: How long does painted cabinet finish last?

acceptedAnswer.text: With proper preparation and the use of high-quality materials, a professional cabinet paint job can last for many years, often 10-15 years or even longer. The longevity of the finish depends on factors such as daily use, maintenance, and the quality of the original application. Using durable, cabinet-specific paints and careful surface preparation are crucial for a lasting result. Regular gentle cleaning and avoiding harsh abrasives will help preserve the finish over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: A professional cabinet paint finish can last 10-15 years or more with proper preparation, high-quality materials, and regular, gentle cleaning.
